sentences.text:
The petitioner claims ownership and  possession of Ac.7.18 cents of land in Sy.No.24-  2A2, Polatitippa Village, Machilipatnam Mandal,
 Krishna District.
This land is now sought to be  acquired for the purposes of distribution of the said  land as house site pattas.

It appears that the  petitioner has raised objections to the notification  issued under Section 11 of the Right to Fair  Compensation and Transparency in Land  Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair  Compensation and Transparency in Land  Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioner has now approached this  Court as he apprehends that possession of his land  would be taken over without completing the  acquisition process and without payment of  compensation.
He is also aggrieved by the non-  consideration of his objections as to the acquisition  itself.
The learned Government Pleader for  Revenue, on instructions, submits that objections  raised by the petitioner have already been placed  before the District Collector for adjudication.

She  would also submit that the primary objection  raised by the petitioner is that his name has not  Contd..
 been shown as the owner and possessor of the said  2 land and steps are now being taken to ascertain the facts.

She would further submit that necessary action for rectification of the notification etc., would be taken upon the verification of the facts and that the objections of the petitioner would be Myneni Venkateswara Rao vs The State Of Ap on 17 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59883922/
1 considered.

sentences.text: In the meanwhile, no steps would be taken against the petitioner until and unless the objections filed by the petitioner are considered and appropriate orders are passed in accordance with law and after payment of compensation, if it is found that the petitioner is entitled to such compensation.
Needless to say, the petitioner shall co-
operate with the respondent authorities for conducting necessary survey to ascertain the ownership and extent of land available with the petitioner.
RRR, J RKS Myneni Venkateswara Rao vs The State Of Ap on 17 April, 2023
